review.imagery: Root reviewed all 29 brochure index spreads and all 20 scoped official website image resources. Fifteen selected original project renders cover the named Palace frontage, arrivals, courtyards, common amenities and apartment concepts. Generic lifestyle banner, colored-overprint duplicate frontage and repeated close courtyard views excluded. Alef project ownership retained despite the Palace brand partnership.
review.floorPlans: Root visually reviewed all 10 staged brochure spreads and all 4 complete colored floorplate sheets, with all 9 enlarged visible numeric tables manually read. Twelve delivered options cover all 9 published sample residence types, colored level 1/2–3/4/5–9 floorplates and two complete location drawings. Net/gross scope preserved. Unpublished detailed drawings for the remaining floorplate types remain explicitly unavailable.
review.location: Root reviewed the web location map, original brochure regional map and marked Palace precinct aerial. All current web and differing community estimates manually read and explicitly qualified. Exact visitor entrance, kilometre journeys and current routes remain unavailable. No surveyed coordinate inferred.
review.provenance: Normal-GET original official project HTML,15 selected website image resources and April 2026 brochure retain dated URL/byte/SHA256 receipts. Separate4-page colored floorplate pack retains honest broker-mirror attribution, original bytes and source links. Protected identity and commercial research preserved.

unavailable: Surveyed visitor entrance, kilometre journeys, live routing, detailed plans for remaining floorplate types and contracted revision remain unverified. Community and current web-map times differ. Original samples and renders do not establish available inventory or final finishes.
